memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Generalised anxiety disorder
  Status: Ongoing, GAD-7 score 12 (mild anxiety).
  Plan: Continue escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, monitor symptoms.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  Status: Deficient, B12 150 pg/mL, Hb 12.8 g/dL, MCV 95 fL.
  Plan: Start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, recheck B12 in 3 months.
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus
  Status: Suboptimal control, HbA1c 7.8%, FPG 150 mg/dL.
  Plan: Metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD.
- Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cutoff 80 cm, slightly increased).
  Diet advice: Breakfast – whole grain toast with egg; Lunch – vegetable dal with brown rice; Dinner – grilled fish with salad.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05.
